name: WayleaveEasementTracker
tagline: Every landowner consent on your build routes – blockers, negotiations, fees and renewals in one app.
description: A complete land-rights app for fibre and network build teams: track wayleaves, easements, licences and Code agreements per route segment, see which consents block a build date and how many homes wait on them, run landowner negotiations with response SLAs and approval rules, and keep annual wayleave payments and renewals under control. Works in canvas and model-driven apps and on Power Pages.
features: Build blockers and homes blocked per consent and route
Route corridor strip in segment order coloured by consent status
Negotiation board with drag and drop and transition rules
Signing with document reference, default term and first payment
Annual payments with record-all and undo
Bulk status, officer assignment and CSV export
controlType: standard (2 controls: WayleaveEasementTracker data-set + WayleaveEasementTrackerPortal field control, shared src/app)
